mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.product_id, f.created_at, p.id AS p_id, p.user_id AS p_user_id, p.name AS p_name, p.price AS p_price, p.stock AS p_stock, p.status AS p_status, p.category AS p_category, p.location AS p_location, p.condition_level AS p_condition_level FROM pms_favorite f JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, created_at AS createdAt FROM pms_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pms_favorite (user_id, product_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pms_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
